statement: Let b ≥ 2, fix a primitive b-th root ζ, and put G = (µb b/µb) ⋊ (Z/b), e = bb , where the denominator is the diagonal subgroup and Z/b permutes the b factors cyclically. There are smooth connected projective curves C, T0, a connected étale G-cover C → T0, and a genuinely G-linearized line bundle L on C with the following properties. (i) The genera and degree satisfy gT := g(T0) = b − 1, g(C) − 1 = e(gT − 1), deg L = e. (ii) There are sections aα ∈ H0(C, L), indexed by α ∈ Zb ≥0 with |α| = b, whose transport follows the degree-b monomial representation in formal homogeneous coordinates p0, . . . , pb−1. The notation pα labels the section aα when |α| = b; it does not assign individual sections of L to the pj. Write aα = pα and set z = 1 b b−1 X j=0 pb j, u = − 1 b b−1 X j=0 ζ−j pb j, v = p0 · · · pb−1. They satisfy pb j = z − ζj u, zb = ub + vb . (5.1) The section z is invariant, and u, v have characters χ, ψ : G → µb, respectively. The pencil u, v is base-point-free and defines a degree-e morphism π : C → P1 with L = π∗O(1). (iii) For a generic A ∈ Pic0 (C), over its field of definition κ, the space EA = H0(C, ALgT ) has dimension e. Multiplication of sections gives isomorphisms H0 (C, ALgT +j ) = EA ⊗κ Symj κ⟨u, v⟩ (j ≥ 0). (5.2) Every a ∈ H0(C, L) consequently acts by a homogeneous linear matrix polynomial Ma(U, V ) ∈ Endκ(EA)[U, V ]. These matrix polynomials commute, preserve all polynomial identities among the sections, and satisfy Mu = U id, Mv = V id, Mb z = (Ub + V b ) id. Their dependence on A is algebraic on a nonempty G-stable open subset of Pic0 (C). Under transport on this family, Mg∗a(U, V ) = (gcoeffMa)(χ(g)U, ψ(g)V ). (5.3) 19 Here gcoeff transports the endomorphism coefficients; scalar choices in identifying transported line bundles have no effect. (iv) The action of G on Pic1 (C) is free. For every character ξ : G → µb, there is a continuous map Pic1 (C) → S1 equivariant for the given G-action and multiplication by ξ on S1.
